column1: # One table, two engines. CategorizerTest runs it on the JVM and
# CategorizerDeviceTest (:feature:capture androidTest) runs the same file on
# Android, where Character's tables come from ICU. Columns, tab separated:
# expected is MATCH (the entry files the key) or NONE (it does not). \uXXXX is
# unescaped by the reader, so a full-width or combining character is visible
# in review and survives an editor that normalises text. Every row is
# constructed: none is a merchant string, only a shape the boundary must hold.
# contains needs a word boundary on both sides.
# prefix is the start of the key, then a boundary.
# exact is the whole key and nothing else; case does not matter.
# A digit counts as part of a word, so a short numeric brand does not match
# Full-width Latin letters and digits are letters and digits.
# Accented letters are letters, and case folds across them.
# A combining mark is neither a letter nor a digit, so it ends a word.
